|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Tragedy Of Plagueis]] (version 1 of 3). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published (21 December 2021). The current text is [[Tragedy Of Plagueis (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 17 release; card image first published 21 December 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Dark/large/tragedyofplagueis.gif</code> as published 21 December 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Dark/large/tragedyofplagueis.gif holotable commit 8190af8] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on table. While Sidious alone, Jedi with him are power and defense value -1. If Revenge Of The Sith on table, your Sidious may be targeted by Force Lightning. Once per game, if Sidious with a Dark Jedi, may retrieve a character into hand. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tragedy Of Plagueis (Errata)]]): Card image published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Dark/large/tragedyofplagueis.gif</code> as published 21 April 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Dark/large/tragedyofplagueis.gif holotable commit 3f7288d] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on table. If Revenge Of The Sith on table, your Sidious may be targeted by Force Lightning and opponent's Objective gains [Theed Palace]. Once per game, if Sidious with a Dark Jedi, may retrieve a character into hand. [Immune to Alter.]” This first 21 April 2022 image prints the [[Theed Palace]] expansion icon after “opponent's Objective gains” (written [Theed Palace]; identified by comparing it with the Theed Palace set icon printed on the Decipher Theed Palace cards, e.g. [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/master/Images-HT/starwars/TheedPalace-Dark/large/3b310.gif 3B3-10], and with the same icon in “non-[Theed Palace] Sidious” on the 21 April 2022 image of [[Coruscant: The Works (Errata)|Coruscant: The Works]], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif holotable 3f7288d]). It was replaced the same day by the next image; no card data or card list carries this wording, so the image is the only source. '''What changed:''' Game text: “While Sidious alone, Jedi with him are power and defense value -1.” was removed; “Lightning.” became “Lightning and opponent's Objective gains [Theed Palace].”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Tragedy Of Plagueis (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 21 April 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set17Type.html Virtual Set 17 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Dark/large/tragedyofplagueis.gif</code> as published 21 April 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8d08c6b2761bb7eba094a1eb4afb597689fc7a92/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Dark/large/tragedyofplagueis.gif holotable commit 8d08c6b] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on table. If Revenge Of The Sith on table, your Sidious may be targeted by Force Lightning and Lord Sidious may use his game text as if alone. Once per game, if Sidious with a Dark Jedi, may retrieve a character into hand. [Immune to Alter.]” The PC published pixel-identical copies of this image on 5 July 2022 (file format change only; no visible change). This first 21 April 2022 image prints the [[Theed Palace]] expansion icon after “opponent's Objective gains” (written [Theed Palace]; identified by comparing it with the Theed Palace set icon printed on the Decipher Theed Palace cards, e.g. [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/master/Images-HT/starwars/TheedPalace-Dark/large/3b310.gif 3B3-10], and with the same icon in “non-[Theed Palace] Sidious” on the 21 April 2022 image of [[Coruscant: The Works (Errata)|Coruscant: The Works]], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif holotable 3f7288d]). It was replaced the same day by the next image; no card data or card list carries this wording, so the image is the only source. '''What changed:''' Game text: “opponent's Objective gains [Theed Palace].” became “Lord Sidious may use his game text as if alone.”
